name: Jeoldae Sarang Geumji Guyeok
source:
Fall in love, and you explode?! Explosive Love Cells have made love itself a danger and a crime. A boy who swore off romance gets tangled up with three girls... Will you survive? No Love Virus is a visual novel where you must keep affection just right to win a heroine's heart. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5239410/]Steam[/url]]
